extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Behavior of a function as input approaches a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Continuity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function has no break and limit equals function value.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Limit of average rate of change; slope of tangent.

extracted_concepts.name: Average Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Change in output over change in input on an interval.

extracted_concepts.name: Instantaneous Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rate of change at a single point.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Line touching a curve at a point with derivative slope.

extracted_concepts.name: Secant Line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Line through two points on a curve.

extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Differentiate x^n as n x^(n-1).

extracted_concepts.name: Product Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of a product uses both functions and derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Quotient Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of a quotient uses numerator and denominator derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Chain Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of a composite function multiplies outer and inner derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Implicit Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Differentiate equations where y is not solved explicitly.

extracted_concepts.name: Inverse Function Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of inverse uses reciprocal of original derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Higher-Order Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of a derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Related Rates
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rates of dependent quantities linked by an equation.

extracted_concepts.name: Linearization
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Tangent line approximation near a point.

extracted_concepts.name: L'Hospital's Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Evaluate indeterminate limits by differentiating numerator and denominator.

extracted_concepts.name: Mean Value Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: There is a point where derivative equals average rate.

extracted_concepts.name: Critical Point
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Point where derivative is zero or undefined.

extracted_concepts.name: Local Extremum
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Maximum or minimum relative to nearby values.

extracted_concepts.name: Absolute Extremum
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Global maximum or minimum on an interval.

extracted_concepts.name: Concavity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Direction of bending determined by second derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Optimization Problem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Find maximum or minimum under constraints.

extracted_concepts.name: Newton's Method
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Iterative method using tangent lines to approximate roots.

extracted_concepts.name: Riemann Sum
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum of rectangle areas approximating area under a curve.

extracted_concepts.name: Definite Integral
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Exact accumulated area from a to b.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects definite integrals and antiderivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Antiderivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function whose derivative is the original function.

extracted_concepts.name: Substitution Method
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Change variable to simplify an integral.

extracted_concepts.name: Area Between Curves
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Integral of vertical distance between curves.

extracted_relations.evidence: Continuity uses limit equal to f(a).
Derivative defined as limit of difference quotient.
Power rule is a differentiation rule.
Product rule is a differentiation rule.
Quotient rule is a differentiation rule.
Chain rule is a differentiation rule.
Implicit differentiation often uses chain rule.
Related rates use derivatives with respect to time.
Applies to limits of indeterminate forms.
States existence of derivative equal to average rate.
Local extrema occur at critical points.
Candidates include critical points and endpoints.
Definite integral is limit of Riemann sums.
Definite integral represented as limit of Riemann sums.
